s0201.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiayin day, Prince Zhenjin was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and appointed to hold the Directorship of the Central Secretariat.
s0201.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the twelfth month an edict invested Prince Zhenjin as Prince of Yan and made him Director of the Central Secretariat.

s0202.literal: On bingchen day an order was issued to the hunting households under Prince Tachar and others to collect only tribute silver; their silk tax was to be remitted to the government offices.
s0202.idiomatic: On bingchen day Princes Tachar and his peers were told that their hunting households should collect only tribute silver and remit the silk tax to the proper offices.

s0203.literal: Army Control Commissions for Henan and Shandong were established; Tarqun Qočin was made Army Controller of the Henan Route with Lu Sheng as his deputy — east from Bozhou west to Jun Prefecture, with all wanhu placed under their command;
s0203.idiomatic: The Henan and Shandong army control commissions were established, with Tarqun Qočin as Henan army controller and Lu Sheng as deputy; their jurisdiction ran from Bozhou in the east to Jun Prefecture in the west, and all wanhu therein were placed under them;

s0204.literal: Chabuhua was made Army Controller of the Shandong Route with Wu Xiu as deputy — west from Suzhou east to Ninghai Prefecture, with all wanhu placed under them.
s0204.idiomatic: Chabuhua was made Shandong army controller, with Wu Xiu as deputy; his command ran from Suzhou in the west to Ninghai Prefecture in the east, and all wanhu therein were placed under him.

s0205.literal: The courier relay stations in all circuits were abolished.
s0205.idiomatic: Courier relay stations in every circuit were disbanded.

s0206.literal: On dingsi day ten circuit Pacification Commissions were established, with Zhao Jin, darughachi of the Zhending Route, and others appointed to them.
s0206.idiomatic: On dingsi day ten circuit pacification commissions were set up, with Zhao Jin, darughachi of Zhending, and others placed in charge.

s0207.literal: On jiwei day, fifty-three persons whose crimes warranted death were ordered to undergo renewed detailed review.
s0207.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict ordered renewed careful review of fifty-three capital cases.

s0208.literal: On xinyou day an edict ordered two hundred plow oxen given to new settlers in Huai Prefecture to plant paddy fields.
s0208.idiomatic: On xinyou day the court granted two hundred plow oxen to new settlers in Huai Prefecture for planting paddy.

s0209.literal: Transport Commissions were established in all circuits, with Cao Ze, Supervisory Control Officer of the Yanjing Route, and others made commissioners.
s0209.idiomatic: Transport commissions were established in every circuit, with Cao Ze of Yanjing's salt and tax office and others as commissioners.

s0210.literal: On guihai day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0210.idiomatic: On guihai day the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0211.literal: An edict stated: "Circuit administrators who also hold wanhu rank shall handle only civil affairs and not intervene in military matters.
s0211.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Circuit administrators who also hold wanhu rank shall govern only civil affairs and keep out of military matters.

s0212.literal: For prefecture and county officials who also hold qianhu or baihu rank, the previous arrangement remains.
s0212.idiomatic: For prefecture and county officials who also hold qianhu or baihu rank, the old arrangement stood.

s0213.literal: " On yichou day Xi Prefecture's walls were rebuilt to settle its people.
s0213.idiomatic: " On yichou day Xi Prefecture's walls were rebuilt to settle the people.

s0214.literal: Wang Pan, Pacification Commissioner of the Zhending, Shunde, and other circuits, was summoned by relay post to the capital.
s0214.idiomatic: Wang Pan, pacification commissioner of Zhending, Shunde, and other circuits, was summoned by relay post to the capital.

s0215.literal: On bingyin day the prohibition against slaughtering cattle and horses was strictly enforced.
s0215.idiomatic: On bingyin day the ban on slaughtering cattle and horses was reaffirmed.

s0216.literal: On jisi day an edict stated: "Among the sons of circuit civilian administrators, those assigned to manage prefectures, fu, commissions, counties, and falcon offices, artisan offices, and various other posts shall be removed.
s0216.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict ordered: "Among the sons of circuit civilian administrators, those put in charge of prefectures, fu, commissions, counties, falcon offices, artisan offices, and other posts were to be removed.

s0217.literal: " On renshen day envoys were dispatched to collect gyrfalcon passes and relay vouchers held by military and civilian officials in all circuits.
s0217.idiomatic: " On renshen day envoys were sent to collect gyrfalcon passes and relay vouchers from military and civilian officials in every circuit.

s0218.literal: On wuyin day an edict stated: "In all circuits, civilian administrators govern civil affairs and military officers command troops — each has his charge, and neither shall supervise the other.
s0218.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict declared: "In every circuit civilian administrators govern civil affairs and military officers command troops — each has his charge, and neither shall supervise the other.

s0219.literal: " Buddhist rites were performed at Haotian Temple for seven days and nights, and fifteen thousand taels of silver were granted.
s0219.idiomatic: " Buddhist rites were performed at Haotian Temple for seven days and nights, and fifteen thousand taels of silver were granted.

s0220.literal: Beijing and Xing Prefecture were detached and placed under Kaiping Prefecture.
s0220.idiomatic: The Beijing and Xing Prefecture districts were transferred to Kaiping Prefecture.

s0221.literal: A traveling palace was built at Longxing Route.
s0221.idiomatic: A temporary palace was erected on the Longxing circuit.

s0222.literal: Linquan County in Taiyuan was promoted to Lin Prefecture;
s0222.idiomatic: Linquan County in Taiyuan was elevated to Lin Prefecture;

s0223.literal: Ningling was reduced to a lower-rank county and remained under Guide Prefecture.
s0223.idiomatic: Ningling was demoted to a lower-rank county and left under Guide Prefecture.

s0224.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, bolts, and silk according to the annual custom.
s0224.idiomatic: Princes received gold, silver, bolts, and silk as in the annual custom.

s0225.literal: That year throughout the empire there were 1,476,146 households; sixty-six persons were sentenced to death.
s0225.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,476,146 households, and sixty-six persons were sentenced to death.

s0226.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on yiyou day, Mongol troops and horses disturbing the people were forbidden.
s0226.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on yiyou day of the first month, Mongol troops and horses molesting civilians were forbidden.

s0227.literal: Song's Jia Sidao sent Yang Lin bearing blank commission appointments, wax-sealed letters, and gold and gifts to entice Yang Dayuan of Daguo Mountain to return south; Dayuan's subordinate officers seized Lin, and an edict ordered his execution.
s0227.idiomatic: Jia Sidao of the Song sent Yang Lin with blank commissions, sealed letters, and gold to lure Yang Dayuan of Daguo Mountain back to the Song; Dayuan's officers seized him, and the court ordered his execution.

s0228.literal: Song Qočin, Mie'er, and troops of the Shazhi Muslim Falcon Office and others were stationed to guard the passes at Shang Prefecture, Lantian, and elsewhere.
s0228.idiomatic: Song Qočin, Mie'er, and forces of the Shazhi Muslim Falcon Office were garrisoned at the passes of Shang Prefecture, Lantian, and elsewhere.

s0229.literal: Military and civilian officials were each to be selected by the Army Control Commissions and Pacification Commissions.
s0229.idiomatic: Military and civilian officials were henceforth chosen by the army control commissions and pacification commissions.

s0230.literal: Yue Tianfu requested that Xi Prefecture be rebuilt; this was not granted.
s0230.idiomatic: Yue Tianfu asked that Xi Prefecture be restored; the court refused.

s0231.literal: On bingxu day Yao Shu was made Left Associate of the Central Secretariat.
s0231.idiomatic: On bingxu day Yao Shu was appointed Left Associate of the Central Secretariat.

s0232.literal: The supervisory control and tax offices in all circuits were converted into Transport Commissions.
s0232.idiomatic: Supervisory salt-and-tax offices in every circuit were reorganized as transport commissions.

s0233.literal: On jiawu day Princess Baihu was granted tally seals, and a darughachi was established for her domain.
s0233.idiomatic: On jiawu day Princess Baihu received tally seals, and a darughachi was appointed over her household.

s0234.literal: Paper notes were granted to relieve the poor in Yidu Route who lacked oxen.
s0234.idiomatic: Paper notes were issued to help Yidu's poor who had no oxen.

s0235.literal: Ordus superintendents were established in ten circuits.
s0235.idiomatic: Ten circuit ordu superintendents were established.

s0236.literal: On dingyou day Sagis, Grand Governor of the Yidu Branch Secretariat, reported the count of Lianshui military and civilian casualties caused by Li Tan and Mongol, Jurchen, and tamaci troops lost to the Song — men and women together totaling 7,922.
s0236.idiomatic: On dingyou day Sagis, grand governor of the Yidu branch secretariat, reported that Li Tan's revolt had cost Lianshui 7,922 military and civilian lives, men and women together, and that many Mongol, Jurchen, and tamaci troops had been lost to the Song.

s0237.literal: On guimao day Ahmad, controller of the secretariat staff, requested ironworks be opened in Henan and elsewhere and patrol forces established in Dongping and other routes to ban private salt; this was granted.
s0237.idiomatic: On guimao day Ahmad, head of the secretariat staff, asked to open ironworks in Henan and elsewhere and establish patrol forces in Dongping and other routes against private salt; the court agreed.

s0238.literal: Shang Ting and Zhao Liangbi were summoned to court.
s0238.idiomatic: Shang Ting and Zhao Liangbi were summoned to the capital.

s0239.literal: On yisi day Li Pingyang was ordered to garrison Qingju Mountain with the Sichuan expeditionary troops under his command; all wing units then at Qingju Mountain were entirely returned to Chengdu.
s0239.idiomatic: On yisi day Li Pingyang was ordered to hold Qingju Mountain with his Sichuan expeditionary troops, while every wing unit then stationed there was sent back to Chengdu.

s0240.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered, with Tarqai and others, to gather and care for dispersed military households.
s0240.idiomatic: The Shaanxi branch secretariat, Tarqai, and others were ordered to gather and support dispersed military households.

s0241.literal: An edict stated: "The ordus of Han troops in all circuits shall no longer be administered by individual wanhu; their levies and taxes in Shandong and Henan shall fall under the Army Control Commissions, in the Eastern and Western Sichuan routes under the Eastern Expedition Grand Marshal's headquarters, and in Shaanxi under the branch Ministry of Revenue.
s0241.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Han troop ordus in every circuit would no longer be run by individual wanhu; their levies in Shandong and Henan would fall to the army control commissions, in eastern and western Sichuan to the Eastern Expedition headquarters, and in Shaanxi to the branch Ministry of Revenue.

s0242.literal: All younger brothers, sons, and private associates of wanhu within ordu offices shall be removed.
s0242.idiomatic: All younger brothers, sons, and private associates of wanhu serving in ordu offices were to be removed.

s0243.literal: " Grand Commander Wang Zhongchen, Grand Marshal Tedi, Liu Zheng, and others were ordered to reinforce troops and hand them to Grand Marshal Qincha to garrison Qingju Mountain, with grain supplied from the salt levy of Jie Prefecture.
s0243.idiomatic: " Grand Commander Wang Zhongchen, Grand Marshal Tedi, Liu Zheng, and others were ordered to send reinforcements to Grand Marshal Qincha at Qingju Mountain, with grain paid from the salt levy of Jie Prefecture.

s0244.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered each wing wanhu to select four thousand picked troops to serve in the Palace Guard.
s0244.idiomatic: On bingwu day each wing wanhu was ordered to select four thousand picked men for the Palace Guard.

s0245.literal: The newly established relay station at Gubeikou was abolished.
s0245.idiomatic: The newly opened relay station at Gubeikou was disbanded.

s0246.literal: One battle supervisor and one counsellor were added to each wanhu headquarters.
s0246.idiomatic: Each wanhu headquarters gained one battle supervisor and one counsellor.

s0247.literal: Captives from Laosengkou in Jinan whom Mahema had taken and whose faces had been tattooed as slaves were restored to their original household registers as commoners.
s0247.idiomatic: People from Laosengkou in Jinan whom Mahema had captured and marked with facial tattoos as slaves were returned to their original registers as free commoners.

s0248.literal: Wang Zhongchen and Shi Quan bound six Song spies and brought them to the capital; an imperial order released them.
s0248.idiomatic: Wang Zhongchen and Shi Quan brought six captured Song spies to the capital, and the Emperor ordered them released.

s0249.literal: On xinhai day the prohibitions against weapons in private homes and against Mongol troops disturbing the people were strictly enforced.
s0249.idiomatic: On xinhai day the bans on civilian weapons and on Mongol troops molesting the people were reaffirmed.

s0250.literal: Möngke, darughachi of Ling Prefecture, was killed in battle at Jinan; his son Mangudai succeeded to the post.
s0250.idiomatic: Möngke, darughachi of Ling Prefecture, fell at Jinan; his son Mangudai inherited the office.

s0251.literal: Zhang Wei, Vice Director of Yunding Mountain, was summoned to court.
s0251.idiomatic: Zhang Wei, vice director of Yunding Mountain, was summoned to the capital.

s0252.literal: In the second month, on the renzi new moon, the Hedong Pacification Commission was ordered to purchase one hundred twenty-nine horses to grant to soldiers under Prince Baraq who lacked mounts.
s0252.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the Hedong pacification commission was told to buy one hundred twenty-nine horses for soldiers under Prince Baraq who had no mounts.

s0253.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered sons of officials in all circuits to enter court as hostages.
s0253.idiomatic: On jiayin day officials throughout the empire were ordered to send their sons to court as hostages.

s0254.literal: Because Goryeo had not answered the imperial edict, its envoy was interrogated.
s0254.idiomatic: Because Goryeo failed to answer the imperial edict, its envoy was rebuked.

s0255.literal: Because the commoner Du Liaoweng had rendered service in a former reign, his household was restored.
s0255.idiomatic: Because Du Liaoweng had served in a former reign, his family's standing was restored.

s0256.literal: On gengshen day two thousand seven hundred fifty taels of silver were awarded to officers and soldiers under Wanhu Kelai who had merit in suppressing Li Tan.
s0256.idiomatic: On gengshen day Kelai's wanhu troops who had merit against Li Tan were rewarded with two thousand seven hundred fifty taels of silver.

s0257.literal: On jiazi day the imperial carriage went to Kaiping.
s0257.idiomatic: On jiazi day the court traveled to Kaiping.

s0258.literal: Wang Desu was made Chief Envoy and Liu Gongliang Deputy Envoy and sent to the Song with a letter to the Song ruler pressing the reason for detaining Hao Jing.
s0258.idiomatic: Wang Desu was made chief envoy and Liu Gongliang deputy envoy and sent to the Song with a letter asking why Hao Jing had been detained.

s0259.literal: An edict stated: "Each circuit shall establish offices for making military equipment; private manufacture is punishable by death;
s0259.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Every circuit shall set up offices for making military equipment; private manufacture is punishable by death;

s0260.literal: Weapons held by the populace that are not surrendered to the government shall be treated the same as private manufacture."
s0260.idiomatic: Weapons held by civilians that were not surrendered to the government would be treated like private manufacture."

s0261.literal: In the third month, on wuzi day, Hu the jiedushi and Fan the vice commissioner of Yizhou were captured by the Song; their families were ordered to be cared for.
s0261.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi day, Hu the military commissioner and Fan the vice commissioner of Yizhou fell to the Song; the court ordered their families provided for.

s0262.literal: Some said they had once guided Song troops; their wives, children, and property were therefore divided and granted to meritorious officers and soldiers.
s0262.idiomatic: When reports surfaced that they had once guided Song troops, their wives, children, and property were divided up and given to meritorious officers and soldiers.

s0263.literal: On xinmao day Sagis was ordered to gather the fugitive populace of Yidu.
s0263.idiomatic: On xinmao day Sagis was ordered to bring back Yidu's fugitive population.

s0264.literal: Dong Wenbing was ordered to bring the captured Song spies and eighty-one prisoners to Longxing Prefecture.
s0264.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing was ordered to escort the Song spies he had captured and eighty-one prisoners to Longxing Prefecture.

s0265.literal: Hunting households and salt patrol and bandit-capture personnel in all circuits were permitted to carry bow and arrow.
s0265.idiomatic: Hunting households and patrolmen hunting bandits and illicit salt in every circuit were allowed to bear bows and arrows.

s0266.literal: On renchen day Jamaluddin was dispatched to purchase grain at fixed prices in Dongjing.
s0266.idiomatic: On renchen day Jamaluddin was sent to buy grain by compulsory purchase in the Eastern Capital district.

s0267.literal: On jihai day tribute silver in all circuits was to be paid in paper notes; silk levies were to be paid in kind; in places that did not produce silk, payment in notes was also permitted.
s0267.idiomatic: On jihai day tribute silver in every circuit was to be paid in paper notes; silk levies were due in kind, but non-silk-producing regions might pay in notes instead.

s0268.literal: For liable households tribute silver was four taels in notes; for every ten households fourteen jin of silk; for unregistered elderly and children three taels in notes and one jin of silk.
s0268.idiomatic: Liable households paid four taels of notes in tribute silver; every ten households contributed fourteen jin of silk; unregistered elderly and children owed three taels in notes and one jin of silk.

s0269.literal: On gengzi day Yihei Dierding requested repairs to Qionghua Isle; this was not granted.
s0269.idiomatic: On gengzi day Yihei Dierding asked to repair Qionghua Isle; the court refused.

s0270.literal: On renyin day Mongol and Han officers east of the passes who had not yet received imperial instructions were each ordered to ride relay post to Kaiping.
s0270.idiomatic: On renyin day Mongol and Han officers in the eastern region who had not yet received imperial briefing were ordered to Kaiping by relay post.

s0271.literal: On guimao day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was first built.
s0271.idiomatic: On guimao day construction of the Imperial Ancestral Temple began for the first time.

s0272.literal: On yisi day Dieqie Noyan and others were granted seven thousand ninety taels of silver.
s0272.idiomatic: On yisi day Dieqie Noyan and others received seven thousand ninety taels of silver.

s0273.literal: Grand Marshal Ahai of Beijing was ordered to send two thousand Han troops to Kaiping.
s0273.idiomatic: Beijing commander Ahai was ordered to march two thousand Han troops to Kaiping.

s0274.literal: On jiyou day the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, sent his minister Zhu Yingliang to offer tribute and submit a memorial thanking the court.
s0274.idiomatic: On jiyou day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent the minister Zhu Yingliang with tribute and a memorial of thanks.

s0276.literal: In the fourth summer month, on the gengxu new moon, 11,800 unregistered households and 4,300 attached households were put to ironworks in various places, with an annual levy of 4,807,000 jin of iron.
s0276.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the fourth summer month, 11,800 unregistered and 4,300 attached households were assigned to ironworks throughout the realm, producing an annual levy of 4,807,000 jin of iron.

s0277.literal: On guichou day one thousand troops from Yidu were selected to serve in the Palace Guard.
s0277.idiomatic: On guichou day one thousand Yidu troops were drafted into the Palace Guard.

s0278.literal: On jiayin day three thousand seven hundred taels of silver were repaid to Asha of Hexi for relief he had given his impoverished followers.
s0278.idiomatic: On jiayin day the court reimbursed Asha of Hexi three thousand seven hundred taels of silver he had spent feeding his poor followers.

s0279.literal: On jiwei day the fields and dwelling of Wanyan Duan were granted to Fu Guozhong, qianhu of Yidu.
s0279.idiomatic: On jiwei day the fields and house of Wanyan Duan were granted to Yidu qianhu Fu Guozhong.

s0280.literal: Guozhong's father Tianyou had been killed by Duan; he was therefore ordered granted Duan's fields and dwelling.
s0280.idiomatic: Because Duan had killed Guozhong's father Tianyou, the court granted him Duan's fields and dwelling.

s0281.literal: Relay stations were placed from Xuande to Kaiping.
s0281.idiomatic: Relay posts were established from Xuande to Kaiping.

s0282.literal: The Pacification Commission of the Kaiyuan Route was abolished.
s0282.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan pacification commission was disbanded.

s0283.literal: On bingyin day frost fell at Wuzhou in the Western Capital region and destroyed the crops.
s0283.idiomatic: On bingyin day a killing frost at Wuzhou in the Western Capital region destroyed the crops.

s0284.literal: On wuyin day Dou Mo and Xu Heng were summoned by relay post to Kaiping.
s0284.idiomatic: On wuyin day Dou Mo and Xu Heng were summoned to Kaiping by relay post.

s0285.literal: Impoverished people under Prince Ajigi who had migrated far were granted horses, oxen, carts, and cloth.
s0285.idiomatic: Poor followers of Prince Ajigi who had migrated far received horses, oxen, carts, and cloth.

s0286.literal: Because Dongping had been trampled by passing armies, relief was granted.
s0286.idiomatic: Because passing armies had trampled Dongping, the court granted relief.

s0287.literal: The salt supervisor's office of Cang, Qing, and Shen was converted into a Transport Commission.
s0287.idiomatic: The Cang-Qing-Shen salt office was reorganized as a transport commission.

s0288.literal: Wang E requested that Taizu's deeds be collected by extended inquiry and delivered to the Historiography Office.
s0288.idiomatic: Wang E asked that Taizu's deeds be gathered by inquiry and sent to the Historiography Office.

s0289.literal: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, an edict ordered five thousand shi of grain transported from Beijing to Kaiping, with cart and ox costs all paid from official funds.
s0289.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, the court ordered five thousand shi of grain shipped from Beijing to Kaiping, with cart and ox costs paid from official funds.

s0290.literal: On yiyou day the Bureau of Military Affairs was first established; the Prince of Yan, holding the Directorship of the Central Secretariat, was concurrently appointed to decide Bureau of Military Affairs affairs.
s0290.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Bureau of Military Affairs was established for the first time; the Prince of Yan, who held the Central Secretariat directorship, was made concurrent head of military affairs.

s0291.literal: On wuzi day Kaiping Prefecture was elevated to Shangdu; its darughachi Urungqi was made darughachi of the Shangdu Route, and Administrator Dong Quan was made Administrator of the Shangdu Route concurrent Prefect of Kaiping.
s0291.idiomatic: On wuzi day Kaiping was elevated to Shangdu; Urungqi was made darughachi of Shangdu Route, and Dong Quan was made route administrator and concurrent Kaiping prefect.

s0292.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered a Stabilization Treasury established at Yanjing to equalize prices and promote the paper-note system.
s0292.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court established a Stabilization Treasury at Yanjing to stabilize prices and promote paper currency.

s0293.literal: On yiwei day the people of Shang Prefecture were ordered to garrison their own prefecture and were not forbidden bow and arrow.
s0293.idiomatic: On yiwei day Shang Prefecture's people were ordered to garrison locally, and they were not forbidden to carry bows and arrows.

s0294.literal: On bingshen day horse and foot relay stations were established at Shangdu.
s0294.idiomatic: On bingshen day horse and foot relay stations were set up at Shangdu.

s0295.literal: On dingyou day Grand Marshals Yang Dayuan and Zhang Dayue, who had merit in recovering Shen Mountain, received an edict of commendation.
s0295.idiomatic: On dingyou day Yang Dayuan and Zhang Dayue, who had merit recovering Shen Mountain, received an edict of praise.

s0296.literal: Ma Yuehenai, Minister of Rites, was concurrently put in charge of the Ying and Guanghua border markets and of three thousand registered households, to operate ironworks yielding 1,037,000 jin of iron annually, cast two hundred thousand farm implements on the spot, exchange them for forty thousand shi of grain for delivery to the government, and the iron merchants in towns throughout Henan were ordered to continue smelting as before.
s0296.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Ma Yuehenai was also placed over the Ying and Guanghua border markets and three thousand registered households to run ironworks yielding 1,037,000 jin of iron a year, cast two hundred thousand farm tools on site, trade them for forty thousand shi of grain for the state, while iron merchants in Henan towns were told to keep smelting as before.

s0297.literal: On gengzi day Liu Kexing, Administrator of the Henan Route, registered households by forged decree; he was dismissed from office and half his property confiscated.
s0297.idiomatic: On gengzi day Liu Kexing, administrator of Henan, conducted a household registration on forged authority; he was dismissed and half his property seized.

s0298.literal: Wangyun County in the Shangdu Route was promoted to Yun Prefecture, and Songshan County to Song Prefecture.
s0298.idiomatic: Wangyun County in Shangdu Route was elevated to Yun Prefecture and Songshan County to Song Prefecture.

s0299.literal: For merit in the earlier campaign against Qunduqai, Saridu, Köke Böke, and others were awarded 2,174 ingots of notes and 1,420 bolts of cloth and silk.
s0299.idiomatic: For service against Qunduqai, Saridu, Köke Böke, and others received 2,174 ingots of notes and 1,420 bolts of silk.

s0300.literal: In the sixth month, on renzi day, locusts afflicted the Hejian, Yidu, Yanjing, Zhending, and Dongping circuits.
s0300.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, locusts struck Hejian, Yidu, Yanjing, Zhending, and Dongping.
